English: This file contains strings used directly by the game engine and no modifications should be made to it by mods.

To redefine a text string from this file, place it in mods.csv and do the change there. Note that redefined engine strings must match exactly the format used by original text or the game could behave abnormally.

This file is loaded just before messages.csv and mods.csv text files and will replace any strings defined by previously loaded text files, but will trigger error on each replacement if extra debug logs are enabled (settings.cfg).
Open this document in Excel, version 5 or later.
To convert the semicolon-separated list to a normal Excel table, first click on the 'A' above to select the entire 'A' column.
Select column 'A' through 'K' (click + drag on letters above columns)
Right-click anywhere on the sheet (inside the selection) and select 'Column width' and set it so that only THREE columns are visible ('45' with 1024 x 768 screen resolution)
Right-click anywhere on the sheet again (still inside the selection) and select 'Format Cells' -> 'Alignment' -> check 'Wrap Text' + select 'Vertical: Top' -> 'OK'

Place the cursor in cell C2 and select 'Window' -> 'Freeze Panes' (allows you to scroll horizontally to see any language in the rightmost column while still having the string names/comments and the English original text in the left and middle column
CAREFULLY read the instructions in cells B26 - B68
1) '%s' is for indicating where another string is inserted by the engine, and MAY NEVER BE REMOVED! If there are more than one '%s' in a string, they may NOT CHANGE PLACES.
2) '%d' is for indicating where integer value is inserted by the engine, and MAY NEVER BE REMOVED! If there are more than one '%d' in a string, they may not change places.

3) '%.0f' is for indicating where non-integer value is inserted by the engine, and MAY NEVER BE REMOVED! 0 can be replaced by another number and defines displayed digits after the decimal point. Add '+' in front of '.' (example: '%+.2f') to display the sign of the number.
4) '%c' is for indicating where a single character is inserted by the engine, and MAY NEVER BE REMOVED!
5) '\%%' can be used to display a single '%' character in texts. Use that with caution and avoid if possible as it could cause issues if used improperly.
6) '%t' is for indicating where the player's 'title' is inserted, however only in game message boxes.

7) The characters '#' (hashmark), semicolon, '%' (percentage sign), '¶' (paragraph sign), quotation marks and '\' (backslash) MAY NOT BE USED (except when used as control codes as this will otherwise create serious problems!!! Quotation marks may not even be used in comments -- use a 'citation mark' (single) instead if necessary!)
8) A dollar sign, '$' will always automatically be replaced by the 'ducats' icon.
9) Any row with a '#' in the first column (column 'A') will be ignored. However, you cannot use any paragraph characters in these rows!!!
10) To insert a carriage return, insert a '\n' (backslash + n)
11) No formatting can be done in this file. To change the color of a text, insert the following codes in front of the word:

Note that the color change will be applied to all words after the code, until the end of the line that the word is printed on. If several words should have a color change, put the code in front of each of them to be on the safe side. If only one word should have a color change, make sure to reset the color after the word.

12) Unless otherwise specifically stated, length of words and texts does not really matter THAT much (message boxes, rollover help boxes and buttons WILL stretch to fit the text string). However you will notice once the translation is inserted that space IS limited in quite a few areas so be brief, and try not to use words that are considerably longer than the English original.
13) ALL CELLS in column 'L' in this document MUST contain a character!
14) The LAST CELL in the 'A' column MUST contain the string '#EOF'
15) If you want to begin a string with a ' (citation mark), you will need to type it twice (Excel will read the first one as a commentary which is not exported into the actual text database file)
16) Test any special punctuation symbols and characters for proper displaying by the game first, before using those in other texts.
Save as 'Semicolon Separated (.csv)' format, and make sure file name is not changed.
If Excel complains about an 'Error in formula' when the cell content begins with a '+' or '-' sign, type a ' (citation mark) in front of the plus or minus.

English: This is the proportion of men and vehicles that are still in fighting shape.
Spanish: Proporción de soldados, armas y material móvil en condiciones de combate activo.

English: This value represents the organization and morale of the men in the unit.
Spanish: Nivel de cohesión orgánica, disciplina y moral combativa de la unidad.

Spanish: Capacidad de fuego y penetración contra blindados, mecanizados y fortines acorazados.

Spanish: Potencia artillera y lesiva de superficie contra navíos hostiles.

English: This is the ability of a unit to withstand attacks from other ships.
Spanish: Capacidad de resistencia estructural y blindaje frente al fuego de buques enemigos.

English: The ability to damage and sink ships
Spanish: Capacidad de aviación para averiar y hundir buques de guerra.

English: The ability of an air division to damage enemy industries, cities and port facilities.
Spanish: Capacidad para destruir infraestructuras fabriles, redes de transporte e instalaciones portuarias enemigas.

English: The defense ability against AA fire.
Spanish: Capacidad de maniobra y blindaje de aeronaves para eludir el fuego antiaéreo desde tierra.

English: The ability to damage and sink Convoys & Escorts
Spanish: Eficacia operativa para diezmar buques mercantes y sus escoltas en rutas marítimas.

English: The ability to sustain enemy fire during attack
Spanish: Capacidad de la unidad para absorber el castigo del adversario al encontrarse a la ofensiva.

English: The max speed this unit can move
Spanish: Velocidad punta de desplazamiento operativo de la formación.

English: The number of attacks this unit has against submarines.
Spanish: Capacidad ofensiva y volumen de fuego para neutralizar sumergibles en inmersión.

English: The ability to suppress enemy during amphibious assaults.

Spanish: Solo podemos ceder contingentes expedicionarios a países aliados.

Spanish: Nuestra línea política no contempla reclamos territoriales sobre %s.

English: We are not part of any Military Alliance so we cannot leave one.
Spanish: No formamos parte de ningún pacto militar multilateral, por lo que no podemos abandonarlo.

English: We cannot leave our current alliance. This is not possible because it is a major alliance and we lead it or are in a war.
Spanish: No podemos abandonar la alianza: lideramos una de las facciones hegemónicas o nos encontramos en estado de guerra activa.

English: We will leave the military alliance with %s.
Spanish: Romperemos la alianza militar que mantenemos con %s.

English: Influence %s to make their policies and views more similar to ours.
Spanish: Ejercer presión diplomática sobre %s para alinear sus doctrinas políticas con las nuestras.

English: Replace the government of %s with a government more loyal to us.
Spanish: Orquestar un golpe en %s para instaurar un ejecutivo afín a nuestros intereses.

Spanish: En guerra, tus tropas pueden penetrar y someter suelo enemigo, canalizando recursos a tus arcas. Al someter todos sus centros estratégicos, podrás proceder a su anexión formal.

Spanish: No puedes declarar la guerra a %s por pertenecer a la misma alianza. Debes abandonarla o forzar su expulsión previamente.

Spanish: Nos han otorgado derechos de tránsito militar -  no se les puede declarar la guerra sin revocarlo antes.

Spanish: Como potencia democrática, no puedes abrir hostilidades en paz salvo que el adversario muestre un índice alto de beligerancia y mantengas una orientación intervencionista acentuada.

Spanish: No puedes declarar la guerra a %s mientras mantenga el estatus de estado títere subordinado.

Spanish: ¡No puedes declarar la guerra a %s mientras combatáis en el mismo bando en una guerra contra un tercer país!

Spanish: Esto nos llevará a pedir la paz, en cuyo caso se restablecerán las fronteras anteriores a la guerra.

Spanish: Debes esperar hasta %s de %d para poder ofrecer la paz de nuevo.

Spanish: Ya hay una oferta de paz sobre la mesa -  no puedes proponer la paz hasta haber respondido a la actual.

English: By Annexing a nation its provinces and military units become yours eternally and irreversibly.
Spanish: Al anexionar una nación, sus provincias y unidades militares pasan a ser tuyas de forma permanente e irreversible.

English: You may only annex a nation if you control its capital and all key provinces.
Spanish: Solo puedes anexionar una nación si controlas su capital y todos sus puntos estratégicos.

Spanish: %s nos permite transitar por su territorio con nuestros ejércitos. No podemos cancelarlo mientras mantengamos tropas dentro de sus fronteras.

English: This represents a particularly forceful sustained attack where the attackers will suffer higher strength losses than normal but will inflict much higher organization damage to the defenders.
Spanish: Ofensiva sostenida de gran intensidad. Los atacantes sufren más bajas en fuerza de lo habitual, pero quiebran severamente la organización de las líneas defensoras.

English: This indicates that the attacking force has briefly managed to pin down and encircle the defenders in a small area of the province. While this effect lasts the defenders will suffer much higher strength losses and the attacker will rarely suffer very much loss of organization (although they may sustain the normal strength losses).
Spanish: Las tropas atacantes han fijado y aislado a los defensores en un sector reducido. Los defensores encajan graves pérdidas de fuerza, mientras que los atacantes apenas sufren merma de organización.

English: The attacker has managed to ambush the enemy forces, inflicting much higher rates of strength and morale damage to the defenders while at the same time greatly reducing the amount of those same types of losses that they sustain themselves.
Spanish: El atacante ha sorprendido a las fuerzas enemigas en una emboscada, infligiendo graves bajas y daño moral al defensor mientras minimiza las pérdidas propias.

English: The defending side is employing a delaying action that greatly reduces the amount of strength loss it sustains during this time.
Spanish: El defensor ejecuta una maniobra de retardo que reduce sustancialmente el número de bajas en fuerza sufridas en este intervalo.

English: During this period, the defender is making a careful tactical withdrawal to a preferred combat location in the province. Both sides will sustain reduced levels of strength and organization loss, but the defender will sustain even lower organization losses than the attacker.
Spanish: El defensor repliega ordenadamente sus líneas hacia posiciones defensivas más ventajosas. Ambos bandos sufren menos bajas, pero el defensor conserva mejor su cohesión que el agresor.

English: The attacker has managed to overrun an enemy's defenses in part of the province. This will seriously disrupt the defender's organization and reduce the strength losses sustained by the attacker.
Spanish: El atacante ha quebrado las defensas enemigas en un punto del sector. Esto desorganiza profundamente al defensor y disminuye las bajas sufridas por las tropas que abren la brecha.

English: Attack missions are given when you want to conquer a province held by the enemy. Your divisions will start to move into the province and fight with any enemy units stationed there.
Spanish: Las misiones de ataque se asignan para capturar una provincia ocupada por el adversario. Tus divisiones marcharán hacia la región y trabarán combate con las fuerzas enemigas acantonadas hasta expulsarlas.

English: Rebase missions are given when you want to redeploy your air units between airfields. The aircraft will then be stationed at a different airfield and be able to stage other missions from there.
Spanish: La reasignación de base transfiere tus alas aéreas hacia un aeródromo distinto, trasladando allí su acantonamiento operativo para operar en nuevos frentes.

English: Rebase missions are used to send your task force to another naval base, changing the supply and oil source for the naval task force to that base. This is different from entering a harbor to load or unload troops which does not change basing.
Spanish: El traslado de fondeadero sitúa tu agrupación naval en otra base marítima, fijando en ella su abastecimiento logístico. Difiere de las maniobras portuarias de estiba de infantería, las cuales no modifican el puerto de base asignado.

English: Strategic Redeployment is the movement of units via rail transport. Your units cannot fight while being strategic redeployed and your ability to transport units that way is limited.
Spanish: El redespliegue estratégico traslada formaciones a través del tendido ferroviario. Las divisiones no pueden entrar en combate durante el transporte y la capacidad simultánea depende de tu infraestructura de transporte.

English: Units with a Support Attack mission will engage enemy units in the province you specify, but will not move into the attacked province when they win the battle. Therefore, it is advisable to give at least one of your attacking armies an attack mission so that they occupy the province.
Spanish: Las unidades en apoyo de ataque abren fuego contra el sector enemigo designado sin avanzar sobre la posición tras doblegar la resistencia. Se recomienda asignar una misión de ataque directo al menos a un cuerpo para asegurar la ocupación.

English: Support Defense missions enable you to keep your units behind the front lines until the enemy attack has started. Any division with this mission will join the defense of the specified province after the enemy attack has started.
Spanish: El apoyo defensivo mantiene contingentes en reserva tras la primera línea. Toda división con esta orden marchará con presteza hacia el sector amenazado en cuanto comience la ofensiva enemiga.

English: Units with Reserves missions are stationed behind the front lines. They will automatically support any province adjacent to them that is under enemy attack.
Spanish: Las divisiones en reserva se ubican tras la vanguardia y acuden automáticamente a reforzar la defensa de cualquier provincia colindante en cuanto sufra una agresión enemiga.

English: Anti-Partisan Duty missions mean that the division will counter any partisan activity in its location or in an adjacent province. The partisan activity rating in the province will decrease over time.
Spanish: El servicio antipartisano combate focos de insurgencia armada y disidencia en la provincia asignada y sectores limítrofes, reduciendo progresivamente la actividad guerrillera y asegurando las rutas de transporte.

English: Air Superiority missions are given to fighter units. They will patrol the target area and engage any enemy planes they encounter.
Spanish: Misión conferida a escuadras de cazas e interceptores para patrullar el espacio aéreo del teatro operativo y abatir las patrullas y bombarderos hostiles que pretendan operar en él.

English: Ground Attack missions are given to Close Air Support or Tactical Bomber squadrons. They will attack enemy ground units in the target area, reducing their strength.
Spanish: Misión ejecutada por aparatos de apoyo aéreo cercano y bombarderos tácticos. Atacan concentraciones terrestres enemigas para infligir bajas directas y mermar su fuerza combativa.

English: Runway Cratering missions are targeted against enemy airfields. They will reduce the airfield level, limiting the number of air units that can be stationed there.
Spanish: Ataques de precisión dirigidos contra instalaciones aéreas para destrozar pistas de rodaje y hangares, limitando de forma drástica el número de aparatos que el enemigo puede mantener en ese aeródromo.

English: Installation Strike missions target the defense installations in the target area, such as AA guns, radar installations, nuclear and rocket facilities.
Spanish: Incursiones de bombardeo dirigidas a neutralizar baterías antiaéreas, emplazamientos de radar, polígonos de cohetes y complejos nucleares en el sector asignado.

English: Ground Support missions are given to your Close Air Support or Tactical Bomber squadrons. They will attack enemy units in the target area and strike their communications, thus reducing their organization level.
Spanish: Bombardeos tácticos orientados a desbaratar enlaces de comunicaciones, puestos de mando y líneas de marcha enemigas, quebrantando velozmente la organización y cohesión de las divisiones de vanguardia.

English: Naval Strike missions target enemy warships in the target sea area. attempting to sink or damage them.
Spanish: Ataques aeronavales contra flotas de guerra hostiles en la demarcación marítima designada con el objetivo de averiar o mandar a pique sus buques.

English: Port Strike missions are targeted at the port facilities of the target area, attempting to hit any ships in port there.
Spanish: Bombardeo de fondeaderos navales con el fin de sorprender, castigar o hundir las escuadras enemigas ancladas en puerto.

English: Logistical Strike missions are targeted at the infrastructure level of the provinces in the target area. This will hamper enemy unit movement and reduce their supply efficiency.
Spanish: Incursiones contra redes ferroviarias, puentes y calzadas del sector. Dificulta los desplazamientos enemigos y deteriora de forma severa su eficacia real de suministro.

English: Strategic Bombardment missions target the enemy's industry. This will reduce his ability to produce supplies, new units and also affect his Transport Capacity. They can only be performed by strategic bomber units.
Spanish: Misión encomendada a bombarderos pesados para arrasar centros fabriles y nudos de transporte. Merma la capacidad industrial (CI) del enemigo, entorpece su producción de pertrechos y colapsa su capacidad de transporte.

English: Air Supply missions are given to transport planes. They will attempt to ferry supplies to your encircled troops, maintaining their fighting efficiency until they can be relieved.
Spanish: Puente aéreo efectuado por transportes para abastecer de munición y raciones a contingentes propios cercados por el adversario, sosteniendo su combate hasta romper el cerco.

English: Airborne Assault missions are given to transport planes that have been loaded with paratroop divisions. The paratroops will be dropped at the specified place and attempt to take that province.
Spanish: Operación aerotransportada donde aparatos cargados con paracaidistas lanzan las fuerzas sobre el área de salto señalada para tomar por asalto la plaza.

English: Convoy Raiding missions strike at enemy convoys, reducing the movement of resources and supplies between his bases and overseas provinces.
Spanish: Operaciones de guerra submarina y de corso destinadas a interceptar mercantes y escoltas, cercenando el flujo de suministros y materias primas hacia las fábricas enemigas.

English: Ships on ASW missions will seek out and attack any enemy submarines in the area. This mission is best given to Carriers, Destroyers and Light Cruisers, as they are best equipped for sub hunting.
Spanish: Caza y destrucción activa de sumergibles hostiles en aguas del sector. Tarea óptima para grupos integrados por destructores, cruceros ligeros y portaaviones de escolta antisubmarina.

English: Naval Interdiction missions assign your fleets to patrol and engage any enemy ships entering the target area.
Spanish: Comisión de patrulla naval orientada a trabar combate y neutralizar a cualquier navío hostil que intente adentrarse en la zona de operaciones asignada.

English: Shore Bombardment missions can only be given to capital ships: battleships, battlecruisers and heavy cruisers. The ships will shell enemy units in the specified area. Furthermore, ships will automatically support any friendly unit in combat in a coastal province that is adjacent to them.

English: Amphibious Assault missions are given to naval transports. They will unload marine and other divisions, which will attempt to take the beach by assault.

English: Sea Transport missions are given to naval transports that have land units loaded on them. They will unload the divisions in the specified province and then return to their home port.
Spanish: Transporte marítimo de tropas entre puertos amigos. Desembarca el contingente en el destino indicado y retorna a su apostadero naval de origen.

English: Ships on a Naval Combat Patrol mission patrol the seazones of the target region and engage any enemy ships they encounter. Because combat patrol covers a larger area than interdiction, your chance of spotting an enemy naval force is correspondingly lower.
Spanish: Patrulla extendida por zonas marítimas de una región amplia para atacar cualquier navío adversario. Al abarcar un área mucho más vasta que la interdicción local, las probabilidades de avistamiento disminuyen proporcionalmente.

English: Bomb Convoy missions are given to bombers with the naval bombing capability. The planes will strike at enemy convoys in the target area, reducing the enemy's ability to move supplies and resources by sea.
Spanish: Ataque aéreo contra convoyes mercantes hostiles efectuado por bombarderos navales, mermando la capacidad del adversario para sostener territorios ultramarinos.

English: Carrier Strike on Port missions are given to the Carrier Air Group of an aircraft carrier. The carrier planes will target enemy ships in the port.
Spanish: Incursión lanzada por grupos aéreos embarcados (GAE) para atacar buques hostiles fondeados al abrigo de un puerto.
